title: Container Seven
pitch: A case of cigarettes walked off container seven on Robbie's shift. He's nineteen and terrified. Get Sal's money back.

clue_a.label: Container seven
lines: The seal log on container seven. Robbie's initials, checked at ten and again at two. Nobody checks a seal twice.

clue_b.label: The water steps
lines: Robbie's moped at the water steps. Carton wrappers bobbing against the pilings. He's been running boxes out this way.
